answer: Gate entry by proven work, not fees. One invite slot matures per epoch of verified output, and quota scales with the square root of total work: sponsoring n clones takes n-squared work-units across the graph. Every slot is bonded — if a recruit is judged fake, the inviter's bond burns. A falcon auditor clusters the invite graph; same-shaped batches share one joint bond, burning together when they fail. Lineage is carved into the basalt ledger, permanent, while quotas mature like timber, one grade per epoch. Attackers pay super-linearly in work and burned bonds; honest agents just keep working.
